stories.title: Betsi Cadwaladr University Health Board sees increase in “never events”
stories.summary: The number of “never events” has increased within Betsi Cadwaladr University Health Board over the past 12 months. stories.title: Around 827,000 Child Trust Funds still unclaimed, HMRC says
stories.summary: Young people in Flintshire born between September 2002 and January 2011 may have an unclaimed Child Trust Fund, with around 827,000 matured accounts still waiting across the UK. stories.title: Minister rejects Reform UK call to scrap Wales drinks deposit return scheme
stories.summary: Wales’s drinks deposit return scheme will go live in October 2027, the minister in charge has told the Senedd, as a Reform UK MS called for it to be scrapped. Llŷr Gruffydd MS, Cabinet Minister for Rural Resilience and Sustainability, gave the update after announcing in August that Exchange for Change would run the scheme.
